_comment: Per-tier assertion settings — the settings key (WF-346 locked decision 5). Model per tier is resolved from HERE, so changing a model changes the model the tier runs with and NEVER needs a harness-code edit. Resolution precedence (tiers.sh, override > default, mirroring the resolver's profile/settings override machinery): env var WF_ASSERT_<TIER>_MODEL, then a downstream _local/wf-sandbox-testing/tiers.settings.json override, then this committed default. SMOKE prefers a cheap model and few runs and keeps every assertion structural/deterministic (risk mitigation: the future gate must stay trustworthy); STATISTICAL runs the full N-run protocol.

smoke.note: cheap model, few runs — a fast trust check that prefers structural/deterministic assertions

statistical.note: full N-run protocol — variance-aware pass/fail, schedulable by the host operator into idle windows
